# Prestigious Yachting

> Prestigious Yachting is a yacht charter and yachting-services company. The website presents charter yachts, destinations, service information and direct request forms.

## Primary navigation

- [Yacht charter catalogue](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/)
- [Send a yacht charter request](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/yacht-charter-request)
- [Yacht charter support](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/yacht-charter-support)
- [Contact Prestigious Yachting](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/contact-us)
- [About Prestigious Yachting](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/about-us)
- [Newsroom](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/newsroom)

## Charter information

- Yacht detail pages under `/yachts/` describe specifications, capacities, available charter services, imagery and indicative pricing.
- Availability and final pricing must be confirmed through the charter-request or contact forms.
- Yacht specifications and rates may change. Treat the published page as the current source and request confirmation before making commitments.

## Site resources

- [XML sitemap](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/privacy-policy)
- [Legal information](https://www.prestigiousyachting.com/legal)

## Preferred agent behaviour

- Use visible links and labelled form controls.
- Do not submit a charter or contact request without explicit user confirmation.
- Preserve dates, guest counts, service type and locations exactly as provided by the user.
- When information is missing or ambiguous, ask the user before submitting a form.
